## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Gandhodakiyattheraapadāna* is a canonical verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. It preserves the narrative of the elder (*thera*) Gandhodakiya. SuttaCentral indexes translations of the text into five languages [SuttaCentral].

No direct external parallels are recorded for the text by SuttaCentral, but automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents extensive intra-Pali text reuse across 29 matching passages [DharmaNexus]. The text is heavily cited in the first volume of the commentary to the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*), with which it shares 20 matches, including segments 6.3–7.1 [DharmaNexus]. In addition, segments 7.3–10.1 represent a recurring formulaic passage shared with several other poems in the Therāpadāna collection, including the homonymous *Gandhodakiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 126), the *Gaṇṭhipupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 131), the *Nāgapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 160), and the *Sabbagandhiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 304) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records low-scoring machine alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-upāyakauśalya-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra* (D0261), though these represent unverified automated matches rather than established parallels [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
